symptom: every native Image (Native Mobile Resources 12.6.0) mxcli created failed mx check 11.13.0 with CE0463 — its `imageUrl` text template was written with a template where mx update-widgets writes none
cause: the Image's editorConfig hides the image-source properties it is not using with hidePropertiesIn(t, v, function(s){switch(s){case "image": return L.filter(p => "imageObject" !== p); …; default: return L}}(v.datasource)) — a list computed by a switch in an immediately-invoked function, which the extractor could not read, so no rule hid imageUrl under the default source
fix: read that exact shape — unguarded, at a function's statement level, each case keeping one member of a known string-array constant, default the whole list — as one `notin` rule per member over the cases that keep it; any other shape stays unread
insight: diffing the stored widget against a copy run through `mx update-widgets` named the exact property (Object.imageUrl TextTemplate set vs null) — but the Type was identical, so the cause was visibility, not the definition. A CE0463 with a clean Type diff points at editorConfig
